title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

London | Hybrid (2 days per week in the office) | £47,000 + benefits

We're working with a leading cultural organisation to recruit a Data Analyst into its growing Audience Analytics team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a team that plays a central role in understanding audience behaviour and shaping organisation-wide strategy. Working with large and varied customer datasets, you'll turn complex data into meaningful insights that help drive decision-making and improve audience engagement.

The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Audience Analyst and wider team, delivering analysis and reporting across multiple audience touchpoints, including ticketing, website sales, exhibition attendance and memberships.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Using SQL to conduct ad-hoc customer analysis, exploratory analysis and deep dives into audience behaviour.

  • Developing and enhancing reports and dashboards using Power BI and Excel.

  • Producing actionable insights and presenting findings to stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Delivering long-form analysis around membership, customer retention, loyalty and exhibition attendance.

  • Supporting digital analytics, analysing website journeys and customer behaviour using GA4.

  • Working with campaign teams to advise on CRM testing and campaign performance.

  • Optimising BI reporting to ensure the right insights are available to key stakeholders.

About You

We're looking for someone with a strong background in customer analytics, audience insight or customer data analysis.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Strong SQL skills and experience analysing large customer datasets.

  • Experience using Power BI to build reports and dashboards.

  • Knowledge of GA4 or digital analytics.

  • A background in customer analytics, with exposure to areas such as customer retention, churn, loyalty, segmentation or lifetime value.

  • The ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience within e-commerce, retail, membership or another customer-focused environment would be advantageous.

What's on Offer?

  • Salary of up to £47,000.

  • Hybrid working, with just 2 days per week in the office.

  • Excellent benefits package.

  • The opportunity to work with a diverse range of customer data and deliver insights that influence organisation-wide strategy.

  • A collaborative team environment where data and audience insight are at the heart of decision-making.

If you're a customer-focused Data Analyst looking for an opportunity to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.
